visualInspection.finding: The original 320x900 failure capture shows the initial authorized-case selection layout. It is diagnostic evidence and adds no final UI qualification or capture count.

interpretation: All 681 profiles reached final rows with activeAsync zero; fulfilled describes Promise settlement, not successful typed product data or an HTTP response.
Each Materiality tree has 34 Finance and 92 case owners plus its own root. All descendants are counted once using final rows; partial checkpoints are never added to final totals.
The two original Materiality observations remain separate. Their duration sum is 64.330118 s; the epoch-rounded first-start-to-second-end window is approximately 64.334685 s.
The original 40 s fetch failed without headers or body. Internal region settlement is not evidence of a late 200 response.

Actual retained-return counters prove 460 hits out of 552 helper calls across both trees. There are 92 first admitted unequal reads, 92 retained baselines and 92 original hashes, with no opaque, closed, busy, pin-refusal or observational-exception fallback.
Admitted unequal includes a first admissible input with no baseline. Baseline retained is cumulative and is not the number of live retained objects.
Inspect (10.642576 s) dominates the new helper timers. Pins (0.047081 s) are not a material performance target in this run. All fresh input inspection and original guards remain intact.
The large-string metadata parse, escaped decode and plain slice spans have zero calls in both trees. A large decoded-string cache is not supported as a fix for this measured Materiality path.
The materializer spends 10.089620 s in JSON.parse(copy.json). These parses create fresh mutable snapshot graphs; their cost does not authorize reusing those graphs.
New 27/22 spans are contained within older 184/47 costs. Do not sum parent and child spans or reuse elapsed differences as a controlled benchmark.

The 40 s API guard, 15 s goto, 300 s case bound, retry 0, workers 1 and all original assertions are unchanged. Conditions, signal cancellation, no browser commands and no JavaScript errors passed; the console-refusal assertion failed on the aborted resource and remains recorded.
Only numeric observations were added to the diagnostic snapshot. They are not product changes and must not be integrated.
